card: Adds an -ipcconnect option to bitcoin-wallet and -ipcbind to bitcoin-node for multiprocess builds, establishing an IPC connection over a local socket to a running node. The bitcoin-wallet utility is currently offline-only and cannot sync or interact with an active node. This change provides the underlying IPC connection scaffold needed for future online commands like wallet sync and RPC serving. It depends on #10102 and #29409 and unblocks #19461.
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto newer versions of base branches including Cap'n Proto IPC interface updates, subtree updates for libmultiprocess, and minor signal handling improvements.
evidence: PR description: 'The idea is that `bitcoin-wallet` can be extended in the future to have some online functionality. For example, there could be a `bitcoin-wallet sync` command that will update balances and sync latest transactions to an unloaded wallet, or a `bitcoin-wallet serve` subcommand that loads a wallet and serves RPC requests...'

PR description: 'This PR is small and doesn't do much. The only visible change is that `bitcoin-wallet` now checks whether a node socket exists on startup and prints "Connected to IPC address" if it can connect it it.'
problem: The `bitcoin-wallet` standalone utility operates only offline and cannot query chain state, sync balances, or trigger wallet RPC operations directly against a running node.

risk.why: Only affects optional multiprocess builds and adds IPC connection startup logic to the offline wallet tool without altering consensus or wallet disk formats.

scope_notes: The diff includes a large subtree update of `src/ipc/libmultiprocess` and commits from base PRs #10102 and #29409; the PR-specific change is isolated to a single commit (37e143e39c) adding IPC connection handling to `bitcoin-wallet`.
summary: Adds an `-ipcconnect` option to `bitcoin-wallet` and an `-ipcbind` option to `bitcoin-node` for multiprocess builds. When configured, `bitcoin-node` listens on a domain socket and `bitcoin-wallet` connects to it on startup before running wallet commands, falling back to offline operation if configured with `-ipcconnect=auto`.
